svg.title: One regulator cell — Z1 and Z2
svg.desc: Cell side and tier heights from the spec; device placement schematic
svg.text: One regulator cell (1 of 49) — tiers from the measured spec
Each cell holds 11 components: 3 high-side GaN, 3 low-side GaN, 3 inductors, 2 flying capacitors (stack card §4). Identical in Z1 and Z2; only the orientation and the neighbours change.
DEVICE PLACEMENT SCHEMATIC — cell side and tier heights true
True proportions: 150 px/mm horizontally and vertically (vertical scale ×1), except layers thinner than 80 µm, drawn 80 µm tall; true thickness labelled.
Z1 — converter embedded between substrate and die
Z2 — converter on the substrate backside, inside the PCB opening
land-side attach RDL (48 V in, 1 V out)10 µm
